name: anteros
description: Anteros：一台 Windows 电脑上跑通的拟人智能体单机闭环（内核 + Windows 主客户端 + 插件）。
author: rifei111

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:kernel && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run build:kernel && npm run dev -w @anteros/client
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w @anteros/client
scripts.verify: npm run build:shared && npm run build:kernel && npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke:kernel
